report_comment.text: GATA2 encodes a zinc-finger transcription factor required for hematopoietic stem/progenitor-cell function. MECOM encodes EVI1/MDS1-associated transcriptional regulators of hematopoiesis. The rearrangement relocates a GATA2 hematopoietic enhancer to MECOM/EVI1, driving EVI1 overexpression while reducing normal GATA2 expression. Its oncogenic mechanism combines enhancer hijacking with GATA2 insufficiency and does not require a GATA2::MECOM coding fusion. AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) is in the adverse genetic-risk group under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.
